test_cases.test_inputs: Audience alanı boş veya tanımsız olan bir e-Devlet SAML assertion.
test_cases.assumptions: Assertion'ın imzası ve geçerlilik süresi kontrolünden bağımsız olarak, bu test yalnızca audience kontrolüne odaklanmaktadır.

steps.action: Audience alanı boş olan bir e-Devlet assertion'ı VBP'ye gönderilir.
steps.expected: VBP, assertion'ı reddeder ve kullanıcı oturumu başlatılmaz.

test_cases.title: Setting a new phone number triggers authenticator binding process
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: New valid telephone number.
test_cases.assumptions: The system implements the NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2 binding process, which typically involves sending a one-time code to the new number and verifying it.

steps.action: Navigate to the profile settings and select the option to change the pre-registered telephone number.
steps.expected: The system initiates the authenticator binding process (e.g., prompts for a new number and sends a verification code to the new number).

steps.action: Enter the new telephone number and submit the request.
steps.expected: A one-time verification code is sent to the new telephone number.

steps.action: Enter the received verification code into the system.
steps.expected: The system validates the code and successfully binds the new telephone number as the authenticator.

steps.action: Check the account profile details.
steps.expected: The new telephone number is displayed as the current pre-registered number.

test_cases.title: Changing an existing phone number triggers authenticator binding process
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: New valid telephone number different from the current one.
test_cases.assumptions: The system treats 'changing' the number identically to 'setting' a new one, requiring re-binding.

steps.action: Navigate to the profile settings and select the option to change the pre-registered telephone number.
steps.expected: The system initiates the authenticator binding process.

steps.action: Enter a new telephone number and submit the request.
steps.expected: A one-time verification code is sent to the new telephone number.

steps.action: Enter the received verification code into the system.
steps.expected: The system validates the code and updates the authenticator binding to the new number.

steps.action: Attempt to receive an SMS code for a subsequent action (e.g., password reset or login verification).
steps.expected: The SMS code is sent to the new telephone number, not the old one.

test_cases.title: Failure to verify new phone number prevents binding
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: New valid telephone number, incorrect verification code.
test_cases.assumptions: The binding process requires successful verification of the code sent to the new number.

steps.action: Initiate the process to change the pre-registered telephone number to a new number.
steps.expected: A verification code is sent to the new number.

steps.action: Enter an incorrect verification code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the code and displays an error message.

steps.action: Check the account profile details.
steps.expected: The pre-registered telephone number remains unchanged (still the old number).

test_cases.title: Binding a second authenticator to an account with one existing authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with one active authenticator bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the account, details for a new authenticator (e.g., new phone number or security key).
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports at least two authenticators per account as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2.1.

steps.action: Log in to the company representative account using the existing authenticator.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated and redirected to the account settings or security page.

steps.action: Navigate to the authenticator management section and initiate the binding of a new authenticator.
steps.expected: The system displays the interface to register a new authenticator.

steps.action: Provide the details for the new authenticator and complete the verification process.
steps.expected: The system confirms the successful binding of the new authenticator.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators for the account.
steps.expected: Both the original and the newly added authenticator are listed as active.

test_cases.title: Binding a third authenticator to an account with two existing authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with two active authenticators bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the account, details for a third new authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows more than two authenticators per account.

steps.action: Log in to the company representative account using one of the existing authenticators.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Initiate the binding of a third authenticator.
steps.expected: The system allows the addition of the new authenticator.

steps.action: Complete the verification for the third authenticator.
steps.expected: The system confirms the successful binding.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators.
steps.expected: All three authenticators are listed as active.

test_cases.title: Attempting to bind an authenticator that is already bound to the account
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with one active authenticator bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the account, details for the same authenticator already bound.
test_cases.assumptions: The system prevents duplicate binding of the same authenticator identifier to the same account.

steps.action: Log in to the company representative account.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Initiate the binding of a new authenticator using the same identifier as the existing one.
steps.expected: The system displays an error message indicating that the authenticator is already bound to the account.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators.
steps.expected: Only the original authenticator is listed; no duplicate entry is created.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at lower AAL when account max is lower than authenticator max
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 2. A new authenticator capable of AAL 3 is ready to be bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account with max AAL 2, New Authenticator with max AAL 3
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports AAL levels 1, 2, and 3 as per NIST SP 800-63B-4.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL 2.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted, and the new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at lower AAL when authenticator max is lower than account max
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 3. A new authenticator capable of AAL 2 is ready to be bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account with max AAL 3, New Authenticator with max AAL 2
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports AAL levels 1, 2, and 3 as per NIST SP 800-63B-4.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL 2.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted, and the new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at AAL 1 when both account and authenticator support only AAL 1
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 1. A new authenticator capable of AAL 1 is ready to be bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account with max AAL 1, New Authenticator with max AAL 1
test_cases.assumptions: AAL 1 is the minimum supported level.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL 1.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted, and the new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Authentication failure when provided AAL is lower than required
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 2. A new authenticator capable of AAL 3 is ready to be bound. The required AAL is 2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account with max AAL 2, New Authenticator with max AAL 3, Authentication attempt at AAL 1
test_cases.assumptions: The system can distinguish between AAL 1 and AAL 2 authentication attempts.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL 1.
steps.expected: The authentication is rejected, and an error message indicating insufficient authentication level is displayed.

steps.action: Check the account status.
steps.expected: The new authenticator is not bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Bağımsız bildirim mekanizması ile doğrulayıcı ekleme bildirimi

test_cases.title: Government identifier and core attributes validation against authoritative source
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. The authoritative source (e.g., government database) contains matching records for the test user's government identifier and core attributes.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid government identifier, matching core attributes (name, date of birth, etc.)
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source is accessible and returns a positive match for the provided test data.

steps.action: Submit a proofing request for a company representative with IAL2 level, providing a valid government identifier and core attributes that match the authoritative source.
steps.expected: The system validates the attributes against the authoritative source and returns a success status indicating IAL2 verification is complete.

steps.action: Check the user profile status in the system.
steps.expected: The user profile is marked as verified at IAL2 level.

test_cases.title: Validation of digitally signed attributes on SUPERIOR evidence
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. A digitally signed evidence document (SUPERIOR evidence) is prepared with a valid signature from a trusted issuer.
test_cases.test_inputs: Digitally signed evidence document containing core attributes, issuer's public key
test_cases.assumptions: The issuer's public key is available in the system's trust store and the signature on the evidence is valid.

steps.action: Submit a proofing request for a company representative with IAL2 level, providing the digitally signed evidence document.
steps.expected: The system validates the digital signature using the issuer's public key and verifies the core attributes within the document.

steps.action: Check the user profile status in the system.
steps.expected: The user profile is marked as verified at IAL2 level based on the validated digital evidence.

test_cases.title: Rejection of proofing when government identifier does not match authoritative source
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. The authoritative source does not contain a record matching the provided government identifier.
test_cases.test_inputs: Invalid or non-matching government identifier, core attributes
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source is accessible and returns a negative match for the provided test data.

steps.action: Submit a proofing request for a company representative with IAL2 level, providing a government identifier that does not exist in the authoritative source.
steps.expected: The system fails the validation and returns an error indicating that the government identifier could not be verified.

steps.action: Check the user profile status in the system.
steps.expected: The user profile is not marked as verified at IAL2 level.

test_cases.title: Rejection of proofing when digital signature on evidence is invalid
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. A digitally signed evidence document is prepared with an invalid or tampered signature.
test_cases.test_inputs: Digitally signed evidence document with invalid signature, issuer's public key
test_cases.assumptions: The issuer's public key is available in the system's trust store, but the signature on the evidence is invalid or tampered.

steps.action: Submit a proofing request for a company representative with IAL2 level, providing the digitally signed evidence document with an invalid signature.
steps.expected: The system fails the signature validation and returns an error indicating that the digital signature could not be verified.

steps.action: Check the user profile status in the system.
steps.expected: The user profile is not marked as verified at IAL2 level.

test_cases.title: Rejection of proofing when core attributes do not match authoritative source
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. The authoritative source contains a record for the government identifier, but the core attributes (e.g., name, date of birth) do not match.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid government identifier, mismatched core attributes
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source is accessible and returns a record for the government identifier, but the core attributes do not match the submitted data.

steps.action: Submit a proofing request for a company representative with IAL2 level, providing a valid government identifier but core attributes that do not match the authoritative source.

steps.action: Check the user profile status in the system.
steps.expected: The user profile is not marked as verified at IAL2 level.

test_cases.title: SMS code generation does not reset failed authentication count
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a non-zero failed authentication count (e.g., 2).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials and phone number.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows generating a new SMS code after failed attempts without locking the account immediately.

steps.action: Attempt to log in with an incorrect password twice to establish a failed authentication count of 2.
steps.expected: The system records 2 failed authentication attempts for the account.

steps.action: Initiate the process to generate a new SMS one-time code for the company representative.
steps.expected: A new SMS one-time code is generated and sent to the representative's phone.

steps.action: Check the account's failed authentication count in the system logs or database.
steps.expected: The failed authentication count remains 2 and has not been reset to 0.

test_cases.title: SMS code generation preserves failed count near lockout threshold
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a failed authentication count of 4 (assuming a lockout threshold of 5).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials and phone number.
test_cases.assumptions: The account lockout threshold is 5 failed attempts.

steps.action: Attempt to log in with an incorrect password 4 times to establish a failed authentication count of 4.
steps.expected: The system records 4 failed authentication attempts for the account.

steps.action: Initiate the process to generate a new SMS one-time code for the company representative.
steps.expected: A new SMS one-time code is generated and sent.

steps.action: Check the account's failed authentication count.
steps.expected: The failed authentication count remains 4.

steps.action: Attempt to log in with an incorrect password one more time (5th attempt).
steps.expected: The account is locked due to reaching the 5th failed attempt, confirming the count was not reset by the SMS generation.

test_cases.title: Multiple authenticator failure threshold triggers disablement
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with password and second-factor (e.g., TOTP) enabled. The account is not currently disabled. The failure threshold defined in VBP SDD §14 is known (assumed to be 5 for this test).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, invalid password, invalid second-factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The failure threshold in VBP SDD §14 is 5 consecutive failed attempts. 'Consecutive' means without a successful login in between. The second factor is a TOTP code.

steps.action: Attempt login with valid username, invalid password, and valid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. The system records a failed attempt for the password authenticator.

steps.action: Attempt login with valid username, valid password, and invalid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. The system records a failed attempt for the second-factor authenticator.

steps.action: Repeat the sequence of failed attempts (invalid password, then invalid second-factor) until the total number of consecutive failed attempts reaches the threshold (5).
steps.expected: The system detects that the threshold of consecutive failed attempts has been reached involving multiple authenticators.

steps.action: Check the status of the password authenticator for the account.
steps.expected: The password authenticator is disabled.

steps.action: Check the status of the second-factor authenticator for the account.
steps.expected: The second-factor authenticator is disabled.

test_cases.title: Single authenticator failure does not disable other authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with password and second-factor enabled. The account is not currently disabled. The failure threshold is 5.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, invalid password, valid second-factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The failure threshold in VBP SDD §14 is 5. The requirement specifies disabling authenticators *involved* in the failures. If only password fails, only password should be affected if the logic is strict, but the requirement says 'if more than one authenticator is involved... disable all'. This test verifies that if only one authenticator is involved in the failures, the other is not disabled by this specific rule (or the rule doesn't trigger). However, the requirement is specific to the case where *more than one* is involved. A safer interpretation for a 'Normal' test of the *negative* case is that if the threshold is reached with only one authenticator failing, the other remains enabled. Let's assume the system has a separate lockout for single factors or simply doesn't trigger the multi-factor disablement rule. The requirement KDH-038 specifically addresses the multi-factor scenario. To test the boundary of this specific requirement, we verify that if only one factor fails repeatedly, the other is NOT disabled by *this* mechanism.

steps.action: Attempt login 5 times with valid username, invalid password, and valid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails 5 times. The system records 5 consecutive failed attempts for the password authenticator.

steps.action: Check the status of the second-factor authenticator for the account.
steps.expected: The second-factor authenticator remains enabled (not disabled by the multi-factor failure rule).

test_cases.title: Successful login resets consecutive failure counter
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with password and second-factor enabled. The account is not currently disabled. The failure threshold is 5.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, invalid password, valid second-factor code, then valid password and valid second-factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The failure threshold in VBP SDD §14 is 5. A successful login resets the 'consecutive' counter.

steps.action: Attempt login 4 times with valid username, invalid password, and valid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails 4 times. The consecutive failure count is 4.

steps.action: Attempt login with valid username, valid password, and valid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds. The consecutive failure counter is reset to 0.

steps.action: Attempt login 4 times with valid username, invalid password, and valid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails 4 times. The consecutive failure count is 4 (not 8).

steps.action: Check the status of the authenticators.
steps.expected: No authenticators are disabled because the threshold of 5 consecutive failures was not reached.

test_cases.title: Authenticator usage before re-binding is blocked
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. An authenticator is bound to this account. The failed-attempt threshold defined in VBP SDD §14 has been reached, causing the authenticator to be disabled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials, the disabled authenticator.

steps.expected: The system explicitly states that the authenticator is disabled due to reaching the failed-attempt threshold and must be re-bound before use.

test_cases.title: Session AAL cannot exceed authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A user is authenticated with AAL1 (e.g., password only). The system allows session attribute modification or context switching.
test_cases.test_inputs: User session with AAL1. Attempt to set session AAL to AAL2.
test_cases.assumptions: The system provides a mechanism (API, admin tool, or internal state) to attempt setting a session's AAL higher than the authentication event.

steps.action: Authenticate a user using a method that results in AAL1.
steps.expected: Session is created with AAL1.

steps.action: Attempt to upgrade the current session's AAL to AAL2 without performing a new AAL2 authentication event.
steps.expected: The system rejects the request or ignores the change, keeping the session at AAL1. An error or warning may be logged.

steps.action: Verify the effective AAL of the session.
steps.expected: The session remains at AAL1.

test_cases.title: Session AAL can be lower than authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A user is authenticated with AAL2 (e.g., password + OTP). The system allows session attribute modification or context switching.
test_cases.test_inputs: User session with AAL2. Attempt to set session AAL to AAL1.
test_cases.assumptions: The system provides a mechanism to downgrade session AAL for specific contexts or policies.

steps.action: Authenticate a user using a method that results in AAL2.
steps.expected: Session is created with AAL2.

steps.action: Attempt to downgrade the current session's AAL to AAL1.
steps.expected: The system accepts the change.

steps.action: Verify the effective AAL of the session.
steps.expected: The session is now at AAL1.

test_cases.title: Authenticated session remains on HTTPS after navigation
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. The user is authenticated via HTTPS.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials, internal link to a protected resource.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal using HTTPS with valid credentials.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated and the session is established over HTTPS.

steps.action: Navigate to a protected internal page within the portal.
steps.expected: The browser address bar displays 'https://' and the connection remains secure.

steps.action: Check the network traffic for the request to the internal page.
steps.expected: The request is sent over TLS/HTTPS and no plaintext HTTP request is initiated by the application.

test_cases.title: Prevention of downgrade to HTTP via direct URL manipulation
test_cases.preconditions: The user is authenticated in an active session over HTTPS.
test_cases.test_inputs: URL with 'http://' scheme pointing to a protected resource.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal using HTTPS.
steps.expected: The user is authenticated and the session is active.

steps.action: Manually change the URL scheme in the browser address bar from 'https://' to 'http://' for a protected resource and press Enter.
steps.expected: The system redirects the request back to the HTTPS version of the URL or rejects the insecure connection.

steps.action: Verify the final state of the browser connection.
steps.expected: The browser displays 'https://' and the session remains active without falling back to insecure transport.

test_cases.title: Bot trafiğinin WAF tarafından engellenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Web Application Firewall (WAF) aktif ve NIST SP 800-63A-4 §3.5 uyumlu kurallarla yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Otomatize edilmiş (bot) HTTP istekleri, standart tarayıcı başlık bilgileri olmadan veya anormal hızda gönderilir.
test_cases.assumptions: WAF loglarına erişim yetkisi vardır.

steps.action: Kimlik doğrulama sayfasına standart tarayıcı User-Agent başlığı olmadan veya otomasyon araçları (ör. curl, python-requests) kullanılarak seri istekler gönderilir.
steps.expected: WAF, istekleri 'Bot' veya 'Otomasyon' olarak sınıflandırır ve engeller (403 veya 429 yanıt kodu).

steps.action: WAF olay günlüğü (log) kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Engellenen isteklerin kayıtları, 'bot detection' veya 'waf block' etiketiyle görünür.

test_cases.title: Anormal davranış analizi ile şüpheli oturumun engellenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Davranış analitiği (behavioural analytics) modülü aktiftir ve eşik değerleri tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tek bir IP adresinden veya oturumdan, kısa sürede çok sayıda başarısız kimlik doğrulama denemesi veya anormal veri girişi hızı.
test_cases.assumptions: Davranış analitiği eşik değerleri (ör. 10 deneme/dk) test ortamında ayarlanabilir veya bilinen bir değerdir.

steps.action: Kimlik doğrulama sürecinde, tanımlı eşik değeri aşacak şekilde (ör. 15 saniyede 10 kez) hızlı ve ardışık hatalı giriş denemeleri yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, davranış analitiği motoru tarafından 'şüpheli aktivite' olarak işaretlenir ve oturum geçici olarak askıya alınır veya ek doğrulama (MFA/CAPTCHA) zorunlu hale gelir.

steps.action: Güvenlik olay yönetimi (SIEM) veya uygulama logları incelenir.
steps.expected: Olay, 'behavioural analytics alert' olarak kaydedilir ve IP adresi veya oturum kimliği ile ilişkilendirilir.

test_cases.title: Ağ trafiği analizi ile enjeksiyon saldırılarının engellenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ trafiği analizi ve WAF kuralları aktiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: SQL enjeksiyonu veya XSS içeren zararlı parametreler içeren HTTP istekleri.
test_cases.assumptions: Zararlı yükler (payloads) OWASP Top 10 örneklerinden alınmıştır.

steps.action: Kimlik doğrulama formu alanlarına SQL enjeksiyonu içeren bir dize (ör. '1 OR 1=1--') gönderilir.
steps.expected: WAF veya ağ trafiği analizi modülü, isteği 'SQL Injection' olarak algılar ve engeller.

steps.action: Kimlik doğrulama formu alanlarına XSS içeren bir dize (ör. '<script>alert(1)</script>') gönderilir.
steps.expected: WAF veya ağ trafiği analizi modülü, isteği 'XSS' olarak algılar ve engeller.

test_cases.title: Normal kullanıcı trafiğinin korumalardan etkilenmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: Tüm otomatik saldırı korumaları (WAF, Bot, Analitik) aktiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Standart tarayıcıdan gelen, normal hızda ve geçerli formatta kimlik doğrulama istekleri.

steps.action: Standart bir web tarayıcısı üzerinden, normal hızda ve geçerli formatta kimlik doğrulama bilgileri girilerek işlem tamamlanır.
steps.expected: İstekler WAF ve bot korumaları tarafından engellenmez, işlem başarıyla tamamlanır.

steps.action: Uygulama logları kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Bu oturum için 'block' veya 'alert' kaydı bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Geçerli TOTP kodunun ilk kullanımında kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı MFA için kayıtlıdır ve geçerli bir TOTP kodu üretilmiştir.

steps.expected: Doğrulama başarılı olur ve kullanıcı işlemine devam eder.

test_cases.title: Aynı geçerli TOTP kodunun ikinci kullanımında reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı MFA için kayıtlıdır ve aynı TOTP kodu daha önce başarıyla kullanılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Daha önce kullanılmış geçerli TOTP kodu

steps.action: Daha önce başarıyla kullanılmış olan TOTP kodu tekrar doğrulama ekranına girilir ve gönderilir.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarısız olur ve kodun kullanılamadığına dair hata mesajı gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Replacement recovery code issuance triggers notification
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with at least one active recovery code. The system is configured to send notifications as per §4.2.1.1.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the company representative. Request to generate a replacement recovery code.
test_cases.assumptions: The notification mechanism (e.g., email/SMS) is monitored in the test environment to verify content and delivery.

steps.action: Log in as the company representative and initiate the process to issue a replacement saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system successfully generates and displays the new recovery code.

steps.action: Check the notification channel (e.g., email inbox) associated with the account.
steps.expected: An account recovery notification is received, containing the details specified in §4.2.1.1 (e.g., timestamp, IP address, action type).

test_cases.title: Kurtarma kodu kullanıldıktan sonra geçersiz kılınması ve yeni kodun oluşturulması
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi için geçerli bir kurtarma kodu (Kod A) kayıtlıdır ve kullanıcı oturum açmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kullanıcı kimliği, Kayıtlı Kurtarma Kodu (Kod A)
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, yeni kurtarma kodunu kullanıcıya güvenli bir kanal üzerinden iletebilmektedir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, hesap kurtarma işleminde kayıtlı kurtarma kodunu (Kod A) girer ve onaylar.
steps.expected: Sistem, Kod A'nın doğruluğunu kabul eder ve kurtarma işlemini tamamlar.

steps.action: Sistem, Kod A'nın durumunu kontrol eder.
steps.expected: Kod A artık geçersizdir ve bir daha kullanılamaz.

steps.action: Sistem, şirket temsilcisine yeni bir kurtarma kodu (Kod B) oluşturup ilettiğini doğrular.
steps.expected: Yeni bir kurtarma kodu (Kod B) oluşturulmuş ve kullanıcıya iletildiği görülmektedir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, eski kurtarma kodunu (Kod A) tekrar kullanarak hesap kurtarmaya çalışır.
steps.expected: Sistem, Kod A'nın geçersiz olduğunu bildirir ve kurtarma işlemini reddeder.

test_cases.title: AAL2 ile başarılı kimlik doğrulama ve hesap erişimi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde AAL2 seviyesinde kayıtlı bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı ve geçerli bir kimlik doğrulayıcı (authenticator) bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kayıtlı kullanıcı adı ve AAL2 seviyesinde geçerli kimlik doğrulama bilgileri (örn. şifre + OTP).

steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur ve kullanıcı temsilci hesabına erişir.

steps.action: Hesap içindeki kişisel bilgi alanları görüntülenir.
steps.expected: Temsilcinin yetkili olduğu kişisel bilgiler başarıyla görüntülenir.

test_cases.title: AAL3 ile başarılı kimlik doğrulama ve hesap erişimi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde AAL3 seviyesinde kayıtlı bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı ve geçerli bir kimlik doğrulayıcı (authenticator) bulunmaktadır.

test_cases.assumptions: AAL3 seviyesinin NIST SP 800-63A-4 §5.2'ye uygun olarak yapılandırıldığı varsayılır.

steps.action: Temsilci hesabına AAL3 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama bilgileriyle giriş yapılır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur ve kullanıcı temsilci hesabına erişir.

steps.action: Hesap içindeki kişisel bilgi alanları görüntülenir.
steps.expected: Temsilcinin yetkili olduğu kişisel bilgiler başarıyla görüntülenir.

test_cases.title: AAL1 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama denemesinin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde AAL2 veya AAL3 seviyesinde kayıtlı bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kayıtlı kullanıcı adı ve yalnızca AAL1 seviyesinde geçerli kimlik doğrulama bilgileri (örn. yalnızca şifre).
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, AAL1 seviyesindeki giriş denemelerini temsilci hesapları için desteklememektedir.

steps.action: Temsilci hesabına AAL1 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama bilgileriyle giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama reddedilir ve kullanıcı hesabına erişemez.

steps.action: Hata mesajı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Yüksek güvenlik seviyesi (AAL2 veya AAL3) gerektiğine dair bir uyarı veya hata mesajı gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Hesaba kayıtlı olmayan kimlik doğrulayıcı ile giriş denemesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde AAL2 seviyesinde kayıtlı bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı bulunmaktadır. Farklı bir hesaba kayıtlı veya hiç kayıtlı olmayan bir kimlik doğrulayıcı (authenticator) mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Temsilci hesabının kullanıcı adı ve başka bir hesaba kayıtlı AAL2 seviyesinde geçerli kimlik doğrulama bilgileri.
test_cases.assumptions: Kimlik doğrulayıcıların hesap bazında eşleştirildiği varsayılır.

steps.action: Temsilci hesabına, o hesaba kayıtlı olmayan bir kimlik doğrulayıcı ile AAL2 seviyesinde giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama reddedilir ve kullanıcı hesabına erişemez.

steps.action: Hata mesajı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulayıcının bu hesaba kayıtlı olmadığına dair bir hata mesajı gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Representative account information update notification
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is active and the notification channel (e.g., email) is configured and monitored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid representative credentials, a changeable field in the representative account (e.g., phone number or address).
test_cases.assumptions: The notification mechanism is configured to send an email to the representative's registered address upon account information updates.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal using the company representative credentials.
steps.expected: The representative dashboard is displayed successfully.

steps.action: Navigate to the account settings and modify a piece of information (e.g., update the phone number).
steps.expected: The system saves the new information and displays a success message.

steps.action: Check the notification inbox of the representative's registered email address.
steps.expected: A notification email is received informing the representative that their account information has been updated.

test_cases.title: Notification content verification for account update
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is active and the notification channel is configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid representative credentials, a changeable field in the representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The notification email contains a subject line and body text that clearly indicate an account update occurred.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal using the company representative credentials.
steps.expected: The representative dashboard is displayed successfully.

steps.action: Modify a piece of information in the representative account (e.g., update the address).
steps.expected: The system saves the new information.

steps.action: Open the notification email received in the representative's inbox.
steps.expected: The email content explicitly states that the representative's account information has been updated.

test_cases.title: Company representative reports unauthorized access
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is active and logged in.
test_cases.test_inputs: Incident type: Unauthorized Access; Description: 'Suspicious login from unknown IP'.
test_cases.assumptions: The system provides a specific UI element or form field for reporting security incidents as per NIST SP 800-63A-4 §5.3.

steps.action: Navigate to the account security or incident reporting section.
steps.expected: The option to report unauthorized access or compromise is visible and accessible.

steps.action: Select the 'Unauthorized Access' incident type and enter a description.
steps.expected: The form accepts the input without validation errors.

steps.action: Submit the incident report.
steps.expected: A confirmation message is displayed indicating the report has been received.

test_cases.title: Company representative reports potential compromise
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is active and logged in.
test_cases.test_inputs: Incident type: Potential Compromise; Description: 'Received phishing email targeting account credentials'.
test_cases.assumptions: The system distinguishes between 'unauthorized access' and 'potential compromise' or allows a general security incident report covering both.

steps.action: Navigate to the security incident reporting interface.
steps.expected: The reporting interface is loaded.

steps.action: Select the option for 'Potential Compromise' and provide details.
steps.expected: The system accepts the input for potential compromise.

steps.action: Submit the report.
steps.expected: The system confirms the submission of the potential compromise report.

test_cases.title: Report submission with empty description
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is active and logged in.
test_cases.test_inputs: Incident type: Unauthorized Access; Description: (empty).
test_cases.assumptions: The system requires a non-empty description for incident reports to be valid.

steps.action: Navigate to the incident reporting section and select 'Unauthorized Access'.
steps.expected: The form is displayed with the description field empty.

steps.action: Submit the form without entering a description.
steps.expected: The system displays a validation error indicating that a description is required.

test_cases.title: Beklenmeyen hata durumunda genel mesaj gösterimi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde beklenmeyen bir hata tetiklenebilecek bir test ortamı veya hata enjeksiyon mekanizması mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Beklenmeyen bir hata tetikleyicisi (örneğin, geçersiz veri formatı veya sunucu tarafı hata simülasyonu).
test_cases.assumptions: Hata enjeksiyonu veya hata tetiklemesi için geliştirici/test aracı erişimi vardır.

steps.action: Sistemde beklenmeyen bir hata tetiklenir (örneğin, geçersiz bir istek gönderilir).
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya genel bir hata mesajı döner.

steps.expected: Mesajda yığın izi (stack trace), SQL sorgusu, gizli anahtar veya token gibi iç detaylar bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Güvenlik hassasiyetli hata durumunda genel mesaj gösterimi
test_cases.preconditions: Güvenlik hassasiyetli bir hata senaryosu (örneğin, yetkisiz erişim denemesi veya kimlik doğrulama hatası) simüle edilebilir.

test_cases.assumptions: Güvenlik testleri için yetkisiz erişim denemeleri yapılabilir.

steps.action: Güvenlik hassasiyetli bir hata tetiklenir (örneğin, yetkisiz bir kaynak erişimi denemesi).
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya genel bir hata mesajı döner.

steps.action: Dönen hata mesajının içeriği incelenir.

test_cases.title: Session cookie HttpOnly attribute verification
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists and the portal is accessible.

steps.expected: The login is successful and a session cookie is set in the response.

steps.action: Inspect the Set-Cookie header for the session cookie in the HTTP response.
steps.expected: The session cookie includes the 'HttpOnly' attribute.

test_cases.title: Non-session cookies HttpOnly attribute verification
test_cases.preconditions: The portal sets at least one non-session cookie that is not meant to be accessible to client-side scripts (e.g., CSRF token cookie).

test_cases.assumptions: A non-session cookie (e.g., CSRF token) is set during the session initialization or login process.

steps.action: Inspect the Set-Cookie headers for any non-session cookies (e.g., CSRF token) in the HTTP response.
steps.expected: All non-session cookies not meant for client-side access include the 'HttpOnly' attribute.

test_cases.title: Session token transfer via Set-Cookie header only

test_cases.title: Strict-Transport-Security header presence on all responses
test_cases.preconditions: The portal is accessible via HTTPS.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid URL for a public page (e.g., homepage) and a valid URL for a protected page (e.g., dashboard after login).
test_cases.assumptions: The VBP Software Design Document §14 defines specific max-age and subdomain values, but the test verifies presence and format compliance with OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 V3.4.1.

steps.action: Send an HTTPS request to a public page (e.g., homepage).
steps.expected: The response includes a Strict-Transport-Security header field.

steps.action: Log in to the portal and send an HTTPS request to a protected page (e.g., dashboard).
steps.expected: The response includes a Strict-Transport-Security header field.

steps.action: Inspect the Strict-Transport-Security header value in both responses.
steps.expected: The header includes 'max-age' and 'includeSubDomains' directives as per OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 V3.4.1.

test_cases.title: Strict-Transport-Security header on error responses

test_cases.test_inputs: An invalid URL that triggers a 404 error.

steps.expected: The response status code is 404.

steps.action: Inspect the response headers for the Strict-Transport-Security field.
steps.expected: The response includes a Strict-Transport-Security header field with 'max-age' and 'includeSubDomains' directives.

test_cases.title: Failed sign-in response consistency for existing and non-existing users
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists in the system. A non-existing user identifier is known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user ID, invalid password. Non-existing user ID, invalid password.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows sign-in attempts with any user identifier format.

steps.expected: The system returns a generic error message (e.g., 'Invalid credentials') and an HTTP status code (e.g., 401 or 200 with error body) that does not indicate the user exists.

steps.expected: The response time is statistically indistinguishable from the response time of the non-existing user attempt (within a small margin of error, e.g., < 100ms difference).

test_cases.title: Failed registration response consistency for existing and non-existing email addresses
test_cases.preconditions: An email address is already registered in the system. A new, unregistered email address is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Existing email address, valid registration data. New email address, valid registration data.
test_cases.assumptions: The registration process validates email uniqueness.

steps.action: Submit a registration request with an already registered email address.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic error message (e.g., 'Registration failed' or 'Please check your email') and an HTTP status code that does not explicitly state the email is already taken.

steps.action: Submit a registration request with a new, unregistered email address.
steps.expected: The system returns the exact same generic error message and HTTP status code as in step 1 (or a success message that does not reveal prior state if the flow is identical, but typically both should be indistinguishable if the requirement implies preventing deduction from *failed* responses; if success is different, the failure case for existing email must not be distinguishable from a generic failure). *Correction based on strict interpretation*: If the requirement is about *failed* responses, we compare the failure of an existing email vs a failure of a new email (e.g., invalid data). However, usually, this test compares the response for 'email exists' vs 'email does not exist'. Let's assume the test compares the response when the email is already taken (a failure state) vs a generic failure or the response for a new email if the system treats both as 'processing'. To be safe, we compare the response for an existing email (failure) with a response for a new email that fails for another reason (e.g., invalid format) or simply ensure the 'email exists' error is not distinct. Let's refine: The requirement says 'prevent valid users from being deduced from... registration... responses'. This implies the response for an existing email should not be different from a response for a non-existing email in a way that reveals existence. Often, systems send a 'check your email' for both. Let's test that.

steps.action: Measure the response time for the registration attempt with the existing email address.
steps.expected: The response time is statistically indistinguishable from the response time of the new email attempt.

test_cases.title: Forgotten password response consistency for existing and non-existing users
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. A non-existing user identifier is known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user ID. Non-existing user ID.
test_cases.assumptions: The forgotten password flow accepts user identifiers.

steps.action: Submit a forgotten password request for a valid user ID.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic success message (e.g., 'If an account exists, a reset link has been sent') and an HTTP status code (e.g., 200).

steps.action: Submit a forgotten password request for a non-existing user ID.
steps.expected: The system returns the exact same generic success message and HTTP status code as in step 1.

steps.action: Measure the response time for the forgotten password request with the valid user ID.
steps.expected: The response time is statistically indistinguishable from the response time of the non-existing user request.

test_cases.title: Help Desk staff can initiate password reset but not set password
test_cases.preconditions: A Help Desk staff account is logged in. A company representative account exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Company representative ID.
test_cases.assumptions: The Help Desk interface has a 'Reset Password' function.

steps.action: Navigate to the company representative's profile in the Help Desk interface.
steps.expected: The 'Reset Password' or 'Initiate Password Reset' option is visible and enabled.

steps.action: Click the 'Reset Password' option.
steps.expected: The system initiates the reset process (e.g., sends a reset link to the user's email or generates a temporary token) and displays a confirmation message.

steps.action: Check the interface for any field or button to directly enter or set a new password for the representative.
steps.expected: No field or button is available for the Help Desk staff to directly set or change the representative's password.

test_cases.title: Help Desk staff cannot change password via API or hidden fields
test_cases.preconditions: A Help Desk staff account is logged in. A company representative account exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Company representative ID, new password value.
test_cases.assumptions: The system has an API endpoint for password management.

steps.action: Attempt to call the password change API endpoint with the Help Desk staff's credentials and the company representative's ID, providing a new password.
steps.expected: The system rejects the request with an authorization error (e.g., 403 Forbidden) or a validation error stating that Help Desk staff cannot set passwords directly.

steps.action: Inspect the HTML source of the Help Desk representative profile page for hidden input fields related to password setting.
steps.expected: No hidden input fields for setting the password are present in the DOM.

test_cases.title: New session token generation upon initial authentication
test_cases.preconditions: User has valid credentials and is not currently authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username and password.

steps.action: Authenticate the user with valid credentials.
steps.expected: The system generates a new session token and returns it to the client.

steps.action: Inspect the backend session store for the user.
steps.expected: The backend contains exactly one active session token associated with the user, matching the token returned in step 1.

test_cases.title: Session token rotation upon reauthentication
test_cases.preconditions: User is currently authenticated with an active session token (Token A).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username and password for reauthentication.

steps.action: Trigger reauthentication (e.g., by logging in again or performing a sensitive action requiring re-auth) with valid credentials.
steps.expected: The system generates a new session token (Token B) and returns it to the client.

steps.action: Attempt to use the previous session token (Token A) to access a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request is rejected, and the previous session token is no longer valid.

steps.action: Attempt to use the new session token (Token B) to access a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request is successful, and the resource is returned.

test_cases.title: Session invalidation upon explicit logout
test_cases.preconditions: User is currently authenticated with an active session token.
test_cases.test_inputs: Active session token.

steps.action: Initiate the logout process using the active session token.
steps.expected: The system processes the logout request successfully.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource using the same session token after logout.
steps.expected: The request is rejected, and the session is considered invalid.

steps.action: Inspect the backend session store.
steps.expected: The session data associated with the token is removed or marked as invalid.

test_cases.title: Session invalidation upon expiration
test_cases.preconditions: User is currently authenticated with an active session token that has a defined expiration time.
test_cases.test_inputs: Active session token.
test_cases.assumptions: The session expiration time can be controlled or waited out for testing purposes.

steps.action: Wait until the session token expires (or advance system time if permitted).
steps.expected: The session token reaches its expiration state.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource using the expired session token.
steps.expected: The request is rejected, and the session is considered invalid.

steps.action: Inspect the backend session store.
steps.expected: The session data associated with the token is removed or marked as invalid.

test_cases.title: Yetkisiz kullanıcı başka bir kullanıcının başvurusuna erişemez
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı A ve Kullanıcı B sisteme kayıtlıdır. Kullanıcı A'nın aktif bir başvurusu vardır. Kullanıcı B'nin bu başvuruya erişim yetkisi yoktur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kullanıcı B'nin oturum bilgileri, Kullanıcı A'nın başvuru kimliği (ID).

steps.action: Kullanıcı B olarak sisteme giriş yapılır.
steps.expected: Giriş başarılı olur, Kullanıcı B'nin paneli açılır.

steps.expected: Sistem isteği reddeder ve 403 (Forbidden) veya 404 (Not Found) hatası döndürür. Başvuru verisi görüntülenmez.

test_cases.title: Yetkili kullanıcı kendi başvurusuna erişebilir

steps.action: Kullanıcı A olarak sisteme giriş yapılır.
steps.expected: Giriş başarılı olur.

steps.action: Kullanıcı A'nın kendi başvuru kimliğini (ID) içeren bir istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: Sistem isteği kabul eder ve başvuru detayları doğru şekilde görüntülenir.

test_cases.title: Başvuru kimliğinin değiştirilmesiyle yetkisiz veriye erişim engellenir
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı A ve Kullanıcı B sisteme kayıtlıdır. Her ikisinin de aktif başvuruları vardır. Kullanıcı B, Kullanıcı A'nın başvurusuna erişim yetkisine sahip değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kullanıcı B'nin oturum bilgileri, Kullanıcı A'nın başvuru ID'si.

steps.action: Kullanıcı B olarak sisteme giriş yapılır ve kendi başvurusunun detay sayfası açılır.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı B'nin kendi başvuru verileri görüntülenir.

steps.expected: Sistem yetki kontrolü yapar ve Kullanıcı A'nın verilerini göstermez. Erişim reddi mesajı veya hata kodu döner.

test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı portalde oturum açmıştır. Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §5.4'te hassas olarak tanımlanan bir işlem mevcuttur.
